title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_psicofonia_na_obra_de_andre_luiz_by_jacobson_sant_ana_trovao_r7s8v (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_psicofonia_na_obra_de_andre_luiz_by_jacobson_sant_ana_trovao_r7s8v' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run.
